Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.seal

Class LabyrinthSealGeometry

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.seal.LabyrinthSealGeometry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class LabyrinthSealGeometry extends Object implements Serializable
Geometry of a straight-through labyrinth seal with teeth on the stator.

All dimensions are stored in metres. Setters accept any length unit supported by LengthUnit (for example "m", "mm" or "inch"). The leakage area is the annulus between the shaft and the tooth tips, A = pi * c * (D + c).

The tooth height is kept for completeness and reporting; none of the correlations in LabyrinthSealFlowCalculator use it, so it is optional.

Version:
1.0
